events.title: Hinge and display-clearance changes

events.title: Incoming housing disposition
events.summary: The bronze-front-housing entry records inspection concerns, a deviation waiver and a new tool planned before DVT. Closure of the entry does not establish corrected later hardware. Credit: Incoming inspection record; Yvonne Lai waiver.

events.title: LCM assembly revision
events.summary: The BOM history records a Mylar addition; it does not identify the material in the undated hinge-noise check. Credit: Shared BOM record.

events.title: Touch-panel lift action
events.summary: The action review reports three glued samples passing a wood-floor drop check and three passing thermal shock. The review date does not supply the individual test dates. Credit: FIH Kelvin, SAT-114.

events.title: Front adhesive entries change
events.summary: The BOM history cancels an older cap-front adhesive entry and adds a front-housing adhesive entry. These are document revisions, without a final test-configuration join. Credit: Shared BOM record.

events.title: Bonding operation documented
events.summary: The assembly instructions define glue dispensing, fixture placement and at least five hours of clamping. Separately dated pages retain their own instruction states. Credit: FIH.

events.title: Bronze alternative compared
events.summary: The filename-dated comparison marks four textured and untextured chip measurements FAIL and darker than the original samples. It does not establish a final color match. Credit: Unsigned comparison.

events.title: Glass appearance and inspection reference
events.summary: Revision 3 defines the glass finish and inspection conditions, distinguishing appearance specification 041-00004 from physical part 431-00004. Credit: Erik Norris, author and approver.

events.summary: The earlier instruction specifies a 0.4 MPa, 20-second press under a December 2016 preparation date. That is a document state, not an employment start or confirmed factory introduction. Credit: FIH.

events.title: Local hinge-noise check
events.summary: The undated report compares a dropped Sativa with an untested sample and records no sound after adding 0.1 mm Mylar. It does not join that local check to the July 10 pass. Credit: Unidentified report author.
